title: Swimmer on Rocky Riverbank in Forest Canyon, 1920s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A vertical amateur snapshot capturing figures relaxing and swimming along a deep river or lake flanked by a steep, sunlit hillside with pine trees. A lone figure stands poised on the rocky outcropping just above the rippling water. The elongated composition is characteristic of 116 or 616 roll film formats popular in the 1920s and 1930s. The reverse features torn black album paper remnants at the corners, showing it was preserved in a classic personal scrapbook.
